description: Only for a founder who joined a venture firm’s or studio’s perks on Programscape through its invite link (for example PSL’s): returns that portfolio’s negotiated deals in the partner’s own words, labelled as the partner’s terms, and the public programs the partner points them to, with their live records. A founder who joined no portfolio gets no deals from it. Needs the founder’s Programscape sign-in.
name: portfolio_perks
title: The founder’s portfolio perks
